FocusIsland is a lightweight productivity island for Windows and macOS. It runs locally, with no account, telemetry, or cloud connection.

### macOS

- Top-center floating productivity island with monitor-aware positioning
- Universal 2 app that runs natively on Intel and Apple Silicon Macs
- Menu bar actions, global shortcuts, local reminders, startup support, and system notifications
- Stays out of the Dock and exits from the menu bar menu
- Requires macOS 12 or newer

### Windows

- Per-user installer and portable executable for 64-bit Windows 10/11
- Tasks, focus timer and stopwatch, daily notes, reminders, insights, native tray, and shortcuts
- Requires Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime

### Downloads

- `FocusIsland_<version>_universal.dmg` — macOS Intel and Apple Silicon
- `FocusIsland_<version>_x64-setup.exe` — Windows installer
- `FocusIsland.exe` — Windows portable executable
- `SHA256SUMS.txt` — verify downloads

The binaries are currently unsigned and not notarized. macOS Gatekeeper or Windows SmartScreen may ask for confirmation.
